components.name: Search Line
components.description: Bottom-anchored ruled line that opens search on home.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #16181a; border-radius: 0; color: #4a4f52; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Thumb-Index Tab
components.description: Die-cut area tab on the right edge; gilt left edge.
components.css: .ds-thumb { min-height: 44px; min-width: 40px; padding: 0 8px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #4a4f52; background: #f4f5f0; border: 1px solid #d5d8d2; border-right: 0; border-left: 2px solid #a98a3e; border-radius: 6px 0 0 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; }

components.name: Ribbon and Resume
components.description: Oxblood ribbon hanging beside the resume line.
components.css: .ds-resume { position: relative; min-height: 72px; padding-left: 28px; font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-ribbon { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 12px; height: 72px; background: #7a1f1f; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 50% 82%, 0 100%); } .ds-resume a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding-top: 12px; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #16181a; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #d5d8d2; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }

components.name: Ruled List Row
components.description: Pinned and recent rows: 44px with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d8d2; color: #16181a; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; }

components.name: Reference Numeral
components.description: Oxblood superscript numeral with a 44pt touch target.
components.html: A verse-like phrase1 continues.
components.css: .ds-text { font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; line-height: 1.62; color: #16181a; } .ds-ref { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.62em; color: #7a1f1f; cursor: pointer; padding: 16px 10px; margin: -16px -10px; } .ds-ref:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Floating Control and Menu Panel
components.description: Round toggle and one ruled paper panel with a gilt top edge.
components.css: .ds-menu { box-sizing: border-box; width: 260px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: rgba(244,245,240,0.96); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid #d5d8d2; border-top-color: #a98a3e; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-menu button { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; text-align: left; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #d5d8d2; background: transparent; color: #16181a; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-menu button:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-menu button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Sync Panel
components.description: Note line plus a full-width action; disabled when up to date.
components.html: Last synced 3 hours ago
components.css: .ds-sync { box-sizing: border-box; width: 260px; padding: 14px 16px; font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; background: rgba(244,245,240,0.96); border: 1px solid #d5d8d2; border-top-color: #a98a3e; border-radius: 6px; } .ds-sync p { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #4a4f52; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-sync button { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid #16181a; border-radius: 6px; background: #16181a; color: #f4f5f0; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sync button:disabled { opacity: 0.5; background: transparent; color: #4a4f52; border-color: #d5d8d2; } .ds-sync button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7a1f1f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Onionskin Sheet
components.description: Translucent bottom sheet with a gilt top edge.
components.html:
Referenced note

Passage text appears here.
components.css: .ds-sheet { display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 8px 20px 16px; background: rgba(244,245,240,0.88); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-top: 1px solid #a98a3e; color: #16181a; font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-sheet h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #4a4f52; } .ds-grip { align-self: center; width: 64px; min-height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; } .ds-grip::before { content: ''; width: 36px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: #d5d8d2; }

components.name: Callout
components.description: Neutral ruled box; title in UI small caps.
components.css: .ds-callout { border: 1px solid #d5d8d2; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: transparent; color: #16181a; font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; } .ds-callout-title { font-family: 'Source Sans 3 Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-caps: all-small-caps; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #4a4f52; } .ds-callout p { margin: 0.25rem 0 0; }

narrative.overview: A note is a page of a thin-paper reference Bible. Bright, slightly cool paper (not cream), near-black ink, small-caps semibold headings, one serif for reading and one small sans for labels. There is no display face, no hero, no card grid, no sidebar. The page is one column at every width (max 40rem); the interface appears only when summoned and is otherwise a ruled line, a few tabs, and a ribbon. The night theme is a designed night page, not an inversion.
keyCharacteristics: Single reading column, 40rem measure, 17px base that scales with the browser setting.
Hairline rules (1px) do the work that boxes and shadows do elsewhere.
Two accents, both rationed: oxblood for the ribbon and reference numerals; gilt for the progress line, page-edge hairline, sheet/panel tops and thumb-tab edges.
Every tap target is at least 44pt; one thumb reaches everything from the bottom of the screen.
Motion is flat and short (180ms, no springs).

rules.name: The Rationing Rule
rules.body: Oxblood appears only on the ribbon and reference numerals; gilt only on edges, tops and the progress line. Quartz defaults that would introduce oxblood are explicitly overridden to neutral or gilt.

rules.name: The Full Ink Rule
rules.body: Body text is full ink, never a grey; grey (ink 2) is for labels and secondary information only.

rules.name: The Study-Bible Rule
rules.body: Headings are semibold small caps in the text serif; never a separate display face, never uppercase.

rules.name: The Numeral Rule
rules.body: Small, tabular, superscript, oxblood: that is what "reference" looks like.

rules.name: The Ghosted Page Rule
rules.body: Anything that rises over the page is translucent paper with a gilt top edge, so the note stays faintly present beneath it.

dos: Do keep text in Literata at full ink on paper; use ink-2 only for labels and secondary text.
Do make every tappable thing at least 44pt, extending the hit area with padding where the visible mark is small (reference numerals).
Do separate rows with 1px rule hairlines and put a 1px gilt line on the top of anything that rises over the page.
Do use the tokens as custom properties so both themes stay in step; when changing a color, update quartz.config.ts too.
Do keep motion at about 180ms, ease, translate or opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Don't add oxblood outside the ribbon and reference numerals, or gilt outside edges, tops and the progress line.
Don't use a sidebar, a hero, a card grid, or a display typeface; the reference-Bible thesis excludes them.
Don't color callout types or links; neutral rules and ink carry them.
Don't fabricate note content in any surface; proof is the real vault.
Don't reach for shadows to create depth; use rules, translucency, and blur.
